questions.question: When was the second counter open?
questions.explanation: The additional counter ran from 9 a.m. to noon on Mondays.
questions.passage: A district office opened a second counter from 9 a.m. to noon on Mondays, when queues were longest. It reassigned two staff members from a back-office unit and added no staff. After four weeks, the average Monday morning wait fell from 32 to 20 minutes. The office had not yet measured waiting times on other days.
